params.name: reportOwner
params.description: The username of the report owner (e.g., ISU_report_owner).

params.name: reportName
params.description: The name of the custom report.

params.name: format
params.description: The output format for the report data. Supported values are json, csv, simplexml, and gdata.

params.name: Worker!WID
params.description: Filter by worker Workday ID (example prompt parameter).

params.name: Effective_as_of_Date
params.description: Filter by effective date (example prompt parameter).

items.docs: Returns data from a custom report published as a web service. The report owner and report name form the path to the report. Supports filtering via report-specific prompt parameters.
